free_resources.title: Ram Dass on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: The official Insight Timer account for Ram Dass, kept by the Love Serve Remember Foundation. It gathers recorded talks and guided meditations from his teaching, free to hear in the app or a web browser.

notes: Insight Timer hub (README §18.7), owner approved 31 Oct 2026: profile link only, no tracks copied. 53k Followers (read 31 Oct 2026). Legacy account: free-resource link only, no "Teaches on".
